android.desc:
Fehu is a personal budgeting app with an AI assistant. You can say or type something like “spent 2500 on groceries,” and the assistant will log the transaction, assign a category, and update your budget.

SPEAK, DON’T BOOKKEEP
The app supports voice and text input for entering transactions. The assistant can create accounts, goals, and spending limits on request, with confirmation required for important actions. You can also attach receipts or bank statements, and transactions will be recognized automatically.

BUDGET UNDER CONTROL
You can set limits by category and track spending. The home screen shows how much is left to spend and highlights overspending. The app also supports recurring payments with reminders on due dates.

GOALS AND SAVINGS
You can create savings goals and track progress, set up an emergency fund, and view a six-month forecast of your finances. There is also a simple “what if income drops” stress test.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
The app supports accounts, cards, and cash in multiple currencies, as well as transfers between them. It can import CSV bank statements. All data is stored locally on your device and is not sent to the developer. You can create a backup file and store it in your own Google Drive. The app includes both simple and advanced interface modes, with no ads and no trackers.

IMPORTANT
The AI assistant requires your own Claude API key from Anthropic, which is set in the chat settings. All other features work without a key.

Fehu is named after the rune of wealth from the Elder Futhark. It is designed to make budgeting quick and simple.
